legal.metaDescription: Ordering, payment, personal data, and returns.
legal.title: Legal information
legal.subtitle: How we handle your order, your payment, and your information.
legal.identityBody: This store operates under the name {siteName}. For any question or complaint, the fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp (see below).
legal.ordersBody: No online payment gateway is used: payment is made to the mobile money account shown at checkout, proof of payment (a screenshot) is submitted with the order form, and a team member confirms the order manually. No card details are ever collected or stored by this site.
legal.privacyBody: At checkout, only your name, phone number, city, and payment proof are collected — solely to process the order and contact you about it. This site does not use any third-party analytics or advertising tools.
legal.returnsBody: [To be completed by the store — accepted return window, conditions (defective, not as described…), and refund process.]
legal.contactBody: For any question about an order or a complaint, contact us directly on WhatsApp.
